## Verification

- [ ] Original public URL and author identity checked
- [ ] No duplicate URL or unsupported achievement claim
- [ ] Upstream original authors credited correctly
- [ ] Executable sources SHA-256 pinned and positive/negative scope recorded, if applicable
- [ ] Catalog JSON and CSV updated together and validation passes
- [ ] Privacy, license, security and public content reviewed
- [ ] No sensitive private corporate logs/credentials/hosts/URLs or embargoed vulnerability data
- [ ] No automatic publication to third-party projects or unapproved release

**Review decision:** PASS / REVISE / BLOCKED (with evidence)
